title: The Contact of Kowloon
author: Marguerite Montrose
blurb: Lior Quintana, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
